description: Wyoming 211 provides free, confidential referrals to community resources statewide. Call or text a resource specialist during posted hours, or use the online directory.
introduction: Wyoming 211 provides free, confidential referrals to community resources statewide. Call or text a resource specialist during posted hours, or use the online directory.

who: Individuals and families looking for Wyoming services.
Providers make their own eligibility and availability decisions.
sections.get: Referrals for food, housing, utility assistance, job training, mental health and other local support.
sections.docs: Have your town or ZIP code and immediate need ready. For an urgent referral, note any deadline or disconnection date. You do not need a complete benefits packet to ask for information.
sections.apply:
1. Call 211 or 888-425-7138, or text your ZIP code to 898211.
  2. The website lists Monday–Friday 8 a.m.–5 p.m. hours.
  3. Use Search Resources for an online lookup.
  4. Contact the referred provider for its application requirements.
sections.after: Record the provider’s details and confirm it serves your location. If it cannot help, ask for alternatives. Use 911 for immediate danger.
sections.sources:
• Wyoming 211 current contact and resources
  • USA Assistance background and screenshots

faqs: Yes, Wyoming 211 describes itself as free and confidential.

The current website lists Monday–Friday 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; the resource directory is available online.
